Discharge teaching after airway suction

Before discharge, confirm that the patient or caregiver can describe when suction may be needed and when urgent help is required.

Home guidance

  • Keep equipment clean, dry, and reachable.
  • Document secretion colour, amount, and patient response after suction.
  • Contact care services if secretions suddenly increase or breathing becomes more difficult.

Urgent care is required if breathing difficulty does not improve after suction.
